 The UV Index

The Ultraviolet (UV) Index predicts the UV radiation levels on a 1 – 11+ scale. The UV Index provides a daily forecast of the expected intensity of UV radiation from the sun. Learn more about how the UV Index can be calculated and analyzed and access the UV Index for your location on EPA’s Envirofacts.
